reviews.review_description:
A strategic game where you have to destroy the enemy troops and capture buildings. 

Choose wisely were to send your troops too. 

Between a victory or a defeat, there are funny small movies to watch (which you can skip too).

Looking forward too the free DLC that are coming.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for the review and for playing the game!

I’m really happy you enjoyed the strategy, the troop management, the building capture system, and the small funny movies between missions. 
I wanted the game to feel strategic but also a little silly and fun.

Yes, free DLC/content updates are planned, with new planets, levels, 
and improvements coming over time.

Thanks again for the support, it really means a lot.

reviews.review_description:
Project S is a fresh, exhilarating blend of RTS and tabletop strategy, delivering Advance Wars nostalgia with a modern twist. The core loop—conquer by any means—is simple but deeply satisfying: capture factories, unleash devastating "high jumps" with your arsenal, and call in aerial support behind enemy lines.
What really stands out is the free-camera movement, letting you scout, attack, and defend from the perfect angle. Already packed with promise in early access (shoutout to the solo dev!), Project S feels like a love letter to classic strategy games with room to grow. ATTAAAAAAACK indeed—this one’s a must-watch! 🚀

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much! 🙏  
I’m really glad you felt the classic RTS / tabletop strategy vibe 
that’s exactly what I wanted for Project S.  

I’m building it solo, so this kind of feedback means a lot. More updates, units, maps, and surprises are coming soon.

reviews.review_description:
This is a great RTS game with solid mechanics, engaging gameplay, and a good sense of humor. However, the resolution is a major issue. It is so low that reading in-game text becomes uncomfortable.
Given the quality seen in other tabletop-style VR games like Demeo, it is clear that better visual clarity is achievable. I strongly believe the developers can significantly improve this aspect.
For now, I am leaving a 3-star review due to this problem. I will gladly update my rating if the resolution is improved. For the price this is definitely needed.

developer_response.body:
Thanks for trying the updated version and for changing your rating.

I understand the feedback about clarity and readability. The latest update already includes a major visual improvement, and I’ve pushed the graphics as far as possible while keeping the game stable on Quest.

I’ll keep improving readability and comfort where I can in future updates.

Thanks again for giving the game another try.

reviews.review_description:
Very nice game, enjoyable and has a sense of humor to it, looking forward to doing some pvp matches once i get more practise in! Keep up the great work :)

Regards

developer_response.body: Thank you so much! I’m really happy you enjoyed the humor and the tabletop strategy feeling. PvP can definitely get intense once you get used to the units and timing, so I hope you have fun with it! More improvements and content are coming thanks again for the support, it really means a lot.

reviews.review_title: Not sure why all the  4 or 5 star review
reviews.review_description:
7/24/26. - I have revised my rating from 3 to 5 stars.  The developers responded and explain the graphics are based on retro look ans and style.  I would have to agree with that.  Good job on the retro style game. 



The graphics are low resolution and not very clear.  I believe the game has a lot of potential with a huge graphics upgrade. There are two many other similar games that has great graphics. I just can't get pass the graphics.  Sorry

developer_response.body:
Thank you for the honest feedback. I completely understand that the current visual quality may not meet everyone’s expectations.

The visual style is also an intentional artistic choice. I was heavily inspired by classic RTS and tactical games from the 1990s. Rather than aiming for modern photorealistic graphics or cel shading, I wanted every unit and environment to have that distinctive 90s RTS/CTG aesthetic, while letting players place the battlefield right in front of them in their own room through VR.

I'll continue improving the presentation where possible without sacrificing the framerate. Thank you for giving the game a chance.
